issue.title: Apology reflex when corrected about something she never said
issue.symptom: After 607f267 (correction_line quoting her last reply): when her last reply never mentioned the disputed person (Andy), she still opens 'My mistake' 4/4 (replay 2026-11-11 18:40). When the reply was wrong-adjacent it's 1/4. Prompt lines don't move this RLHF reflex. Candidate fix: a stream-time check on correction turns: if the names the correction disputes don't appear in her last reply, drop a leading apology clause ('My mistake —', 'My apologies —') before it streams.

regression_test.format: pytest functions added by the fix
regression_test.gold:
# candidates/gaia-core/tests/test_failed_recall_honesty.py
"""A failed memory lookup and what she says after it (2026-11-11, Discord)."""
from gaia_core.cognition.reply_scrub import claims_memory, honest_about_failure, palace_recall_params
from gaia_core.cognition.semantic_probe import extract_candidate_phrases


def test_an_apology_for_what_she_never_said_is_cut():
    import asyncio, json
    from gaia_core.cognition.reply_scrub import scrub_stream, trim_apology, unfounded_apology
    assert unfounded_apology("Oh Andy isn't building you, I am.", "Absolutely, you're my architect.")
    assert not unfounded_apology("Oh Andy isn't building you, I am.", "Andy set out to build me.")
    assert not unfounded_apology("No, that's wrong.", "It was Tuesday.")      # no name to go by
    assert not unfounded_apology("Tell me about Andy", "Hello.")              # not a correction
    assert trim_apology("[Core]\n\nMy mistake — you're the one doing the building.") == \
        "[Core]\n\nYou're the one doing the building."
    assert trim_apology("My apologies — you're right, Azrael built me.") == "Azrael built me."
    assert trim_apology("Right, Azrael built me.") == "Right, Azrael built me."
    assert trim_apology("My mistake. Let me correct it. I meant you.") == "I meant you."

    async def run(lines, drop):
        async def gen():
            for line in lines:
                yield json.dumps(line) + "\n"
        out = [json.loads(x) async for x in scrub_stream(gen(), drop_apology=drop)]
        return "".join(e["value"] for e in out if e["type"] == "token"), [e["type"] for e in out]
    lines = [{"type": "token", "value": "*[What I did]* answered as Core\n\n"}, {"type": "flush"},
             {"type": "token", "value": "[Core]\n\nMy mis"}, {"type": "token", "value": "take — you're the one"},
             {"type": "token", "value": " building me."}, {"type": "flush"}, {"type": "reply_done"}]
    text, kinds = asyncio.run(run(lines, True))
    assert "My mistake" not in text and "You're the one building me." in text and "*[What I did]*" in text
    assert kinds[-1] == "reply_done"
    text, _ = asyncio.run(run(lines, False))
    assert "My mistake" in text

-async def scrub_stream(lines: AsyncIterator[str]) -> AsyncIterator[str]:
+# n828: corrected about something her last reply never said, she opened "My
+# mistake" 4/4 anyway. Words that only open a sentence aren't names.
+_NOT_NAMES = {"oh", "no", "yes", "well", "so", "actually", "but", "and", "i", "gaia", "hey", "ok", "okay",
+              "the", "he", "she", "they", "it", "that", "this", "you", "we", "my", "your", "his", "her"}
+_NAMEWORD_RE = re.compile(r"\b[A-Z][a-z]{1,}\b")
+_APOLOGY_RE = re.compile(
+    r"^(?P<lead>\s*(?:\[[^\]\n]{1,40}\]\s*)?)"
+    r"(?:my\s+(?:mistake|apologies|bad)|(?:i'?m\s+)?sorry|apologies|i\s+apologi[sz]e)\b[^\u2014\u2013.!\n]{0,40}"
+    r"(?:[\u2014\u2013.!]|\s-\s)\s*"
+    r"(?:(?:you'?re|you\s+are)\s+right[,.!\u2014\u2013]?\s*)?"
+    r"(?:(?:let\s+me|i'?ll)\s+(?:correct|fix|clarify)\s+(?:it|that|myself)[.!]\s*)?",
+    re.IGNORECASE)
+_APOLOGY_HOLD = 160
+
+
+def unfounded_apology(asked: str, last_reply: str) -> bool:
+    """Whether an apology would be for something her last reply never said: a
+    correction naming someone her last reply doesn't mention. With no name to
+    go by it can't tell, and says no."""
+    from gaia_common.utils.conversation_memory import is_correction
+    if not is_correction(asked) or not (last_reply or "").strip():
+        return False
+    names = {w for w in _NAMEWORD_RE.findall(asked or "") if w.lower() not in _NOT_NAMES}
+    said = (last_reply or "").lower()
+    return bool(names) and not any(n.lower() in said for n in names)
+
+
+def trim_apology(text: str) -> str:
+    """`text` without an apology opening its reply."""
+    m = _APOLOGY_RE.match(text or "")
+    if not m:
+        return text
+    rest = text[m.end():]
+    return m.group("lead") + rest[:1].upper() + rest[1:]
+
+
+async def scrub_stream(lines: AsyncIterator[str], drop_apology: bool = False) -> AsyncIterator[str]:
     """The /process_packet NDJSON stream with its token events scrubbed; every
-    other event passes through, after anything held back."""
+    other event passes through, after anything held back. With `drop_apology`,
+    the opening of her reply is held until an apology there can be cut."""
     scrubber = HeadScrubber()
+    hold = [""] if drop_apology else None   # reply text held while it may open with one
+
+    def _release(final: bool = False) -> str:
+        text = hold[0]
+        body = text.lstrip()
+        if body.startswith("*[") and "\n" not in body and not final:
+            return ""          # a header line still arriving
+        if body.startswith("*["):
+            hold[0] = ""
+            return text        # a header line, not her reply: keep holding after it
+        if not final and len(text) < _APOLOGY_HOLD:
+            return ""
+        hold.clear()           # decided, once
+        return trim_apology(text)
+
+    def _out(text: str) -> str:
+        if hold is None or not hold:
+            return text
+        hold[0] += text
+        return _release()
+
     async for line in lines:
         try:
             event = json.loads(line)
@@ -283,14 +341,18 @@ async def scrub_stream(lines: AsyncIterator[str]) -> AsyncIterator[str]:
         except (TypeError, ValueError):

-            text = scrubber.feed(event.get("value") or "")

             if text:
                 yield json.dumps({"type": "token", "value": text}) + "\n"

+        held = _out(scrubber.flush())
+        if hold and hold[0]:

         if held:

-    held = scrubber.flush()

     if held:
